sections.content: The conditional is useful for giving advice in a less direct and more hypothetical way. The pattern Si yo *fuera* tú, + conditional presents the speaker's recommendation as a possible choice rather than an order.

items.spanish: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría con el profesor antes de cambiar de curso.
items.english: If I were you, I would speak to the teacher before changing courses.

items.spanish: Yo no aceptaría el trabajo sin leer el contrato con cuidado.
items.english: I would not accept the job without reading the contract carefully.

items.spanish: En tu lugar, buscaría una alternativa que fuera más segura.
items.english: In your position, I would look for an alternative that was safer.

items.spanish: Si tuviera más información, esperaría antes de decidir.
items.english: If I had more information, I would wait before deciding.

sections.content: Conditional advice is deliberately less direct than an imperative. It is especially natural when the speaker recognises that the final decision belongs to the other person.
